# Lubumbashi OpenSourceRail Campaign
<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-marketing-campaigns.py. -->

Municipality outreach package for **Lubumbashi, DR Congo**. Figures are
screening outputs for discussion, not a bid, endorsement or construction release.

## Audience

- Office of the Mayor or city executive for Lubumbashi
- Lubumbashi municipal transport and urban-planning authority
- Lubumbashi climate, energy or sustainability office
- Lubumbashi municipal finance and investment unit

## Local proposition

| Measure | Current planning result |
|---|---:|
| Population represented | 2,829,000 |
| Lines / route length | 5 / 130.0 km |
| Line-platform stops / fleet | 41 / 161 trainsets |
| Practical capacity ceiling | 803,520 passenger-trips/day |
| Station/depot PV / storage | 15.8 MW / 94.0 MWh |
| City programme CAPEX | $1.01 B |
| Local capital and value share | $765 M (75%) |
| Illustrative external-capital saving | $1.58 B |
| Annual OPEX planning value | $23 M |

Lead with locally buildable infrastructure, open design review, renewable-energy
integration and a staged feasibility process. Do not lead with the comparator;
it is an illustrative sensitivity, not a vendor quotation.

## Call to action

Ask for a 30-minute technical review, nomination of a municipal counterpart,
access to current mobility/land/utility data, and agreement on the scope of an
independent feasibility study. Verify the recipient in
[`contact-research.csv`](../../../../contact-research.csv)
before sending.
